request.style: English, deep male solo voice with gospel choir harmony, piano, electric bass, soft drums, electric guitar, warm and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He was separated from you for a while
So that you might have him back forever
My child Onesimus born in my chains
A spiritual father in prison's silence

[Pre-Chorus]
I am sending him back to you now
And with him goes my very heart
I would have liked to keep him near
To serve me in your place so dear

[Chorus]
No longer as a slave to be
But better than a slave as free
A dear brother in the Lord is he
Dear to me but dearer to you
Welcome him as you would welcome me
For we are partners in this new decree

[Verse]
If he has wronged you in any way
Or owes you anything that is paid
Charge it to me I am the debt
In the gospel truth we do not fret

[Chorus]
No longer as a slave to be
But better than a slave as free
A dear brother in the Lord is he
Dear to me but dearer to you
Welcome him as you would welcome me
For we are partners in this new decree

[Bridge]
Tychicus speaks of my situation
Beloved brother and faithful servant
Onesimus comes with them to tell
The faithful brother we can well

[Chorus]
No longer as a slave to be
But better than a slave as free
A dear brother in the Lord is he
Dear to me but dearer to you
Welcome him as you would welcome me
For we are partners in this new decree

[Outro]
Your kindness voluntary and free
Welcome him as you would welcome me
